prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: approval image for Rakky Ride mobile Notifications screen.
Primary request: generate ONE complete polished flat portrait mobile screen, logical 390 x 844. No phone frame or perspective. Clean white-forward ride-hailing app, forest green actions, muted silver separators, soft mint unread backgrounds, charcoal titles and gray-green secondary text. Compact Inter-like typography: page title 15px, row titles 14px, body 13px, time labels 12–13px. Utility icons only 16–18px inside 32px soft circles, back tap target 44–48px, buttons 44px tall. No oversized heading, illustrations, 3D artwork or giant cards.
Composition:
Normal small status bar at top.
Compact header: pale silver circular back arrow, title "Notifications" modest 15px, and a small right-aligned forest-green action "Read all". Thin silver separator under header. No long header subtitle.
Below, two equal-width compact rounded filter controls with 12px gap and 20px page margins: selected forest-green "All" with white text; unselected pale silver "Unread" with charcoal text. Height44px, small labels.
Content section heading "Today" muted 13px.
Three notification rows, about 90px each, subtle rounded corners and 8px vertical gaps:
1 UNREAD row with a very faint mint fill, NO green border. Small amber car-with-magnifier outline icon at left inside a muted amber circle. Main text "No drivers found", body "Try requesting again in a few minutes.", time "10:42". Small green dot at upper right, tiny green label "New" beside dot. Body allowed to wrap two short lines.
2 UNREAD row with same faint mint fill. Small green wallet outline icon inside pale green circle. Title "Wallet top-up successful". Body "₦2,000 was added to your wallet." Time "09:15". Same small "New" and dot at upper right.
3 READ row, white surface with subtle bottom divider, small neutral car-check outline icon on pale silver circle. Title "Trip completed", body "Your receipt is ready in Rakky Ride.", time "08:30". No New label or unread dot. No large chevrons.
Section heading "Yesterday", muted13px.
Two READ rows in the same compact white style:
4 small green package outline icon in pale silver circle, title "Package delivered", body "The recipient confirmed the handoff.", time "18:20". No unread dot.
5 small neutral support headset outline icon in pale silver circle, title "Support case updated", body "Your support case is now resolved.", time "14:05". No unread dot.
Below rows, a restrained full-width outlined button with forest-green text "Load more" and small downward chevron, 44px tall. Leave comfortable white breathing space before bottom home indicator.
Constraints: all messages, amounts and times are fictional design samples, not user data. No names, addresses, precise locations, profile avatars, bank accounts, payment cards, actual private activity, promotions, navigation bar, settings cog, or delete controls. Keep every title, body, and time readable with no clipping. Single screen, no annotation labels outside the UI. Amber warns about missing drivers, green indicates wallet credit, unread treatment stays subtle. No notification is marked read as part of this proposal. Exact readable copy with correct ₦ currency symbol.
